r4_odd_parity_sensitivity.interpretation: The engine computes the R4 (quartic, parity-even operator) odd-parity l=2 ringdown sensitivity d(omega)/d(eta_2) = -1728 * e_10 ~ -3.184 -5.637 i (M=1) by combining a source-backed modified potential (2205.05132) with a source-backed transfer coefficient (McManus e_10). eta_2 > 0 lowers the ringdown frequency. This is the parity-even R4 slice; the parity-odd operator axis g_R4_c3 stays dark (v2.209).
